fields.name: Confirm preservation renewal filing / 核查保全续期申请
fields.next: Counsel checks source order and filing receipt / 律师核查来源裁定及申请回执
fields.notes: External filing must be authorized and performed by qualified counsel. / 对外提交必须获得授权，并由具备资格的律师执行。

fields.name: Verify settlement authority / 核验和解权限
fields.next: Obtain business owner signature authority / 取得业务负责人签署授权
fields.notes: No signature, payment, concession, or acceptance until authority is confirmed. / 权限核验完成前，不得签署、付款、让步或接受和解。

fields.name: Collect scope evidence / 收集服务范围证据
fields.next: Request signed scope and delivery records / 请求已签范围文件及交付记录
fields.notes: Use minimal access. Do not expose privileged material to unapproved readers. / 采用最小访问权限；不得向未经批准的读者披露受保密特权保护的材料。
